subject: general
question: Which instrument is used to measure very high temperature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pyrometer.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pyrometer,** the device for measuring relatively high temperatures, such as are encountered in furnaces.
 
• Most pyrometers work by measuring radiation from the body whose temperature is to be measured.
 
• Radiation devices have the advantage of not having to touch the material being measured.
 
• Radiation Pyrometers are used to measure the temperature of red hot metals up to** 3000°C.**
